analyst_view.overall: Early view: Lille (2nd) host Auxerre between a trip to Le Mans and a Champions League game at Stuttgart on 9 December, so selection may be close to full strength. Auxerre under Will Still have the worst defence in the league, but almost all of those goals came away from home (5-1 at Strasbourg, 4-1 at Rennes).

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. I stay close to it: Auxerre's away defending pulls it up, but Lille score only 1.4 a game and concede 0.7, so their games are usually tight. Cameron Archer gives Auxerre a route to goal, which rules out going much lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners. I lean lower: Lille win only 3.6 corners a game (14th) and Auxerre 4.7. Lille's patient build-up creates fewer corners than their league position suggests.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. I lean slightly higher: Auxerre commit the most fouls in the league (16.3 a game) and took three yellows at home to Paris FC. Away from home, chasing the ball against a good side, that is likely to continue.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.5 shots. Season averages (Lille 11.4, Auxerre 11.1) land right on that, so I stay with it. Neither side is a high-volume shooting team.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. Lille average 5.0 on target and Auxerre 4.5, so the site's figure looks fair. Nothing in the news points either way yet.
